responsibility: Declares the public interfaces and cache entry types for GCC’s inliner subsystem. It exposes edge growth/time/hint caching, analysis query helpers, early-inliner and transform entry points, clone bookkeeping, and inline statistics used across IPA passes. This header is the shared API layer joining the heuristic, analysis, and transformation pieces of the inliner.
same_name_distinction: Provides the inliner subsystem’s shared declarations: cached edge-growth entry type, estimate/query helpers, transform entry points, and exported counters/summaries. Unlike gcc/ipa-inline.cc, it does not contain the heuristic algorithms or pass bodies; it is the interface glue across analysis, heuristics, and transforms.
